title: Ansel and the Choir
author: Ulyana Sterling
blurb: Ivo Quintana, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
